ov: أوغاد مجهولون (الإنجليزية: Inglourious Basterds) هو فلم حرب أُنتج عام 2009 من تأليف وإخراج كوينتن تارانتينو ويقوم ببطولته براد بيت وكريستوف فالتز وميلاني لوران. الفلم يروي قصة تاريخة بديلة حول حبكتين لاغتيال القيادة السياسية لألمانيا النازية، الأولى خططت بواسطة شابة يهودية فرنسية تملك دار عرض سينمائية والأخرى بواسطة فريق من المجندين اليهود يقوده الملازم ألدو راين براد بيت.
plotEn:
In 1941, Austrian SS-Standartenführer Hans Landa, nicknamed "The Jew Hunter," interrogates French dairy farmer Perrier LaPadite about a fugitive Jewish family, the Dreyfuses. Suspecting he is hiding the Dreyfus family, Landa plays cat-and-mouse with LaPadite. Speaking English so the Dreyfuses will not understand, Landa compels LaPadite to give up the Dreyfuses to save his own family. LaPadite tearfully admits the Dreyfuses are hiding under his floor. Landa's men massacre the Dreyfuses, but one, young Shosanna, escapes alive. 
Three years later, U.S. Army First Lieutenant Aldo Raine recruits Jewish American soldiers to the "Basterds", a black ops commando unit tasked with instilling fear among Nazis in occupied France by killing and scalping them. The group includes Sergeant Donny "The Bear Jew" Donowitz, Privates First Class Smithson Utivich and Omar Ulmer, rogue German Sergeant Hugo Stiglitz, and Austrian-born translator Corporal Wilhelm Wicki. Raine carves swastika marks on foreheads of surviving German soldiers so they cannot hide their Nazi affiliations after the war.
In Paris, operating a cinema under the name "Emmanuelle Mimieux", Shosanna  meets Fredrick Zoller, a famed German sniper set to star in the German propaganda film Stolz der Nation (Nation's Pride). Infatuated with "Emmanuelle", Zoller convinces Joseph Goebbels to hold the film's premiere at her cinema.
